items.title: Resolve local references against the actual document base
items.why: The live validator resolves ../assets/ against the document directory rather than the base URL. It can approve a missing browser target if a same-named file exists in the document directory.
items.recipe: Reuse native URL resolution and parse real base href attributes with the existing attribute grammar; decode entities, respect first base, ignore comments/dynamic bodies, and pin browser-relative semantics with regression and mutation fixtures.
items.acceptance: Native URL differential cases and a real browser agree for relative/root/query/encoded bases. Missing browser target fails even when the former validator target exists. Existing self-tests and all tracked pages pass.

premises.claim: Relative base values are discarded by the current resolver

items.userOutcome: Prevent broken navigation and assets reaching visitors through false-positive local-reference validation.
items.stageRationale: Repair a reproduced acceptance gap without changing product identity or user flows.

L2.recipe: Browser-faithful base resolution, real attributes, entity handling, differential and mutation verification.

L3.recipe: Full HTML parser and CSS resource graph; unselected.

executionLog.note: Local implementation verified: 49 self-tests, 16 real Chromium differential cases, all 31210 references across 339 pages. Two independent FIX rounds corrected all six findings with regressions. Full release acceptance remains pending.
